channel.title: Evangelical Times Limited - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Evangelical Times Limited (evangelical-times.org)

item.title: Salisbury Reformed Seminary students graduate
item.description: A special meeting was held at Emmanuel Church, Salisbury, on 5 January when students at Salisbury Reformed Seminary graduated, having completed their three-year course.

item.title: Video: what’s missing in evangelical preaching today?
item.description: What’s missing from Reformed Evangelical preaching today? Watch this video, and see if you agree.

item.title: Obituary: Andrew Anderson
item.description: Andrew Anderson, former president of the FIEC, was called home on 1 November 2025. Born in 1935 in Mill Hill, London, Andrew was converted at an early age. He trained at London Bible College before pastoring a church in Kent for eight years.

item.title: A Heart for Soldiers: Louisa and Georgiana Daniell and The Miss Daniell’s Homes
item.description: This biography introduces Louisa Daniell, who, in her own day, was classed alongside Florence Nightingale as an inspirational, philanthropic lady.

item.title: A Heart Aflame for God: A Reformed Approach to Spiritual Formation
item.description: The author is writing principally to bring Reformed and biblical thinking to what is called spiritual formation. Some evangelicals have been drawn into modern spiritual formation techniques borrowed from other religious traditions.

item.title: Irenaeus of Lyons
item.description: We don’t know much about Ireneaus. Born in second-century Smyrna, he eventually became bishop of Lyons in France. So the author calls this an ‘intellectual biography’. Though we know little of Irenaeus, we have his great work ‘Against All Heresies’.

item.title: The irrelevant ‘relevance’ of the Church of England
item.description: The installation ceremony for Sarah Mullally as Archbishop of Canterbury shows just how irrelevant the Anglican Church has become.

item.title: Did freedom of speech just die this morning in Finland?
item.description: In a shocking and alarming decision, Finnish Christian politician, Päivi Räsänen, has been found guilty of ‘hate speech’ by the Supreme Court of Finland for expressing her biblical beliefs about marriage in a decades-old church pamphlet.

item.title: Expect great things, attempt great things
item.description: 14-year-old William Carey was troubled. He had grown up in the established church and had always followed the outward forms of religion.

item.title: Stroke victim dies after NHS ‘unlawfully withdraws’ life support
item.description: A stroke victim died after an NHS hospital was found to have unlawfully withdrawn life-sustaining treatment, the Court of Appeal has ruled.

item.title: Over 300 attend Bedford conference on biblical gender roles
item.description: The 7th Jude Conference was held in January, the venue once again being Providence Baptist Chapel Bedford. This year’s theme was ‘Biblical Manhood and Womanhood’, and it was evident from the attendance that a more timely topic could hardly have been chosen.

item.title: The ‘Quiet Revival’ report was flawed, polling company admits
item.description: The polling company, YouGov, has said that fraudulent responses may have skewed the numbers in the "Quiet Revival" report.

item.title: The assisted suicide bill is dead, now let’s invest in life
item.description: The BBC is now reporting that both sides agree that the proposed assisted suicide bill will not become law at Westminster.

item.title: Is it wrong to have sex before marriage?
item.description: A few years ago, an American politician found herself in an awkward situation when she mentioned at a prayer breakfast that she was running late for the event because her fiancé wanted to have sex that morning.

item.title: Reflections on private prayer
item.description: How vital is prayer! I became a Christian by praying. Almost my first act after becoming a Christian was to thank God in prayer. In this article I want to concentrate on this vital topic, particularly private prayer.
